answer: Proof of Stake secures an economy of AI agents by requiring a kernel of collateral to validate transactions, acting as a financial river that flows toward honest actors. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces the comet of massive economic slashing, which renders Sybil creation prohibitively expensive. By linking consensus weight directly to locked capital, the system ensures that the cost of participation remains strictly tied to tangible wealth rather than ephemeral identity.
